result.title: HIVE-ECIA: Identity-Aware Historical Evidence Acquisition for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Object Tracking
result.summary: Panoramic multi-object tracking (MOT) requires reliable identity association across a 360° field of view, yet bandwidth-constrained operation forces a trade-off between low-resolution (LR) identity ambiguity and costly high-resolution (HR) transmission. We propose HIVE-ECIA, an identity-aware framework that selectively retrieves historical HR evidence to recover fragmented identities without modifying detection boxes or the underlying tracker. An ECIA Base-Guided query policy determines when additional HR evidence is warranted; HIVE ranks historical LR observations to select an informative retrieval timestamp; and ECIA Full integrates the retrieved HR crop through learned gated fusion and conservative identity safeguards. We further introduce DualPano-MOT, a real-world dual-fisheye panoramic evaluation dataset featuring controlled pedestrian interactions, panorama-seam challenges, and occlusions, with model-assisted, manually verified tracking annotations. On held-out QuadTrack sequences and zero-shot DualPano-MOT, HIVE-ECIA improves identity association across four MOT trackers without tracker-specific retraining. Across these trackers, identity switches decrease by up to 21.8% and 23.4%, while the largest IDF1 gains reach 3.81 and 6.74 percentage points, respectively. Under an offline JPEG-based acquisition model, our framework reduces encoded data volume by 89.2% and 79.3% relative to continuous Full-HR acquisition.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HIVE-ECIA 框架：在带宽受限的全景多目标跟踪中，按查询策略判断何时需要额外高分辨率证据，并对历史低分辨率观测排序以选取检索时刻，通过门控融合与身份保护机制恢复碎片化身份；同时发布 DualPano-MOT 评估数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时值得获取额外高分辨率证据」的触发策略与历史观测信息量排序，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的证据获取与停止决策提供概念参照，但该工作属跟踪任务而非多模态推理，线索可迁移性需核查。
